launch_policy.activation: configuration only; live invocation remains disabled

recommendations.llm: Use OpenAI for the initial commercial launch; retain Groq as a disabled future optional comparator.
recommendations.stt: Use OpenAI for the initial commercial launch; retain Deepgram and Groq as disabled future optional comparators.
recommendations.female_voice: Use an eligible OpenAI Indian-English female voice for launch after listening approval; retain Azure and Google as disabled future optional comparators.
recommendations.male_voice: Use an eligible OpenAI Indian-English male voice for launch after listening approval; retain Azure and Google as disabled future optional comparators.
recommendations.avatar_timing: Use provider-neutral viseme/audio-offset events when verified for en-IN, otherwise the existing approximate lip-sync fallback.
recommendations.pilot_budget: USD 150 SANDBOX_CEILING for a 20-person internal evaluation cohort; it is not a production cost or capacity forecast.
recommendations.usage_limits: 15 minutes per learner/day, 20 practice days, 120 audio seconds/request, 4096 tokens/request, provider kill switch and hard monthly stop.
recommendations.supported_browsers: Current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari after microphone/playback acceptance testing.
recommendations.go_no_go: OpenAI-only launch policy approved; production activation remains NO_GO until credentials, retention, current quotes, cohort quality, latency, browser support and incident controls are separately approved.
